guides.title: 次二奈米邏輯製程研究：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Sub-2-nm logic process research: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「節點名稱」建立判讀邊界。節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Interpret node names to define the interpretation boundary. A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜節點名稱：檢查結果是否能支持「節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜接觸瓶頸：檢查結果是否能支持「通道改善可能被增加的存取電阻抵銷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜研究提案交付：檢查結果是否能支持「提出可量測假說、對照組及失敗判準才可檢驗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Interpret node names: Check whether the evidence supports: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Locate contact bottlenecks: Check whether the evidence supports: Channel improvements can be offset by access resistance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a research proposal: Check whether the evidence supports: A testable proposal needs measurable hypotheses, controls and failure criteria. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸瓶頸」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「研究提案交付」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Locate contact bottlenecks: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a research proposal to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「節點名稱」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「接觸瓶頸」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret node names and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for locate contact bottlenecks and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
